## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] `dotnet build` is warning-free and `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` passes
- [ ] No clipboard content, personal data or real secrets in code, tests, logs or screenshots
- [ ] No new network access, polling or periodic timers
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
- [ ] UI changes: screenshot with demo data and the relevant part of `docs/manual-test-checklist.md` checked
